acceptanceCriteria: A changed Go package without tests appears in the affected output as an unknown or as a vet/build-only selection, covered by a test, and the owning spec records the rule.
body: Filed on 2026-09-23 from the V1-0012 daily-loop measurement (PR #87, run-001). All 5 treatment-only consequence misses in run-001 were changed Go packages with no _test.go file; `corvint affected` silently omits them, so the consequence job failed against the plain-Git baseline. See benchmarks/daily-loop-v0/runs/run-001.json once PR #87 merges.

completion.reason: Completed 2026-09-23: already delivered on main by V1-0187 (commit 4630bd4, present at main 34e798b). AFP-V0-020 (docs/specs/affected-plan-v0.md:352, :385) names a changed Go package with no selectable test as UNKNOWN scope in the affected plan, and the spec records the rule. Tests: TestSelectNamesChangedUntestedGoPackageAsUnknownScope (internal/liveverify/affected/affected_test.go:178) and TestAffectedUntestedGoPackageIsUnknownScope (cmd/corvint/affected_test.go:239). Evidence digests: sha256 at 34e798b of both test files, select.go and affected-plan-v0.md. No new change was made for this ticket; NOT_RUN: make gate (owner focused-verification policy).

title: affected: changed Go packages with no `_test.go` file are neither selected nor listed as unknown
